report_name: KRYBIT Ransomware Claims Attack on National Airline of Tanzania

threat_actors.name: KRYBIT
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that practices double extortion by breaching networks, exfiltrating data, and encrypting files. The group claimed responsibility for the attack on Air Tanzania on its dark web leak site.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: Considered a viable initial access vector, as credentials for Air Tanzania's domain were reportedly available from previous breaches, enabling credential stuffing attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The likely method used by attackers to transfer exfiltrated Passenger Name Record (PNR) data and internal corporate documents to their own infrastructure after staging it on a compromised server.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The final stage of the attack, where KRYBIT ransomware is deployed to encrypt servers and workstations to cripple the airline's operations and force them to negotiate.

attack_patterns.name: Archive Collected Data
attack_patterns.description: Attackers likely compress and stage data on a compromised server before transferring it to their own infrastructure, potentially using tools like 7-Zip.

malware.name: KRYBIT Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload deployed by the KRYBIT group to encrypt servers and workstations at Air Tanzania, crippling operations as part of a double-extortion campaign.

tools.name: 7-Zip
tools.description: A compression utility potentially used by attackers to archive sensitive data before exfiltration, as suggested by hunting hints for command-line patterns.

identities.name: Air Tanzania Company Limited
identities.description: The state-owned national flag carrier airline of Tanzania, listed as a victim on the KRYBIT ransomware group's data leak site. The attack threatened flight operations and sensitive passenger data.

infrastructure.name: KRYBIT Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by the KRYBIT ransomware group to publicly name Air Tanzania as a victim and threaten to publish stolen data as part of their double-extortion tactics.
